postgresql.connections.ref: https://docs.datadoghq.com/opentelemetry/guide/metrics_mapping/ (postgresql.connections <-> postgresql.backends); labels from docs/DASH0_INVENTORY.md. Semantic note: backends counts all backend types; Datadog connections counts numbackends. Grain dedups resource-hash churn (docs/DASH0_INVENTORY.md#caveats)

postgresql.percent_usage_connections.expression: sum by (service_instance_id) (max by (service_instance_id, postgresql_database_name) ({otel_metric_name="postgresql.backends", otel_metric_type="sum"$filters})) / on (service_instance_id) max by (service_instance_id) ({otel_metric_name="postgresql.connection.max", otel_metric_type="gauge"$filters})
postgresql.percent_usage_connections.ref: Derived: Datadog postgresql.percent_usage_connections = connections / max_connections (no 1:1 OTel metric).
